roles.title: Software Engineer, Founding Team
roles.description: Founding engineer owning the agent layer and the AWS production backend, shipping GTM MVP features alongside the founders.
highlights: Led development of Carla, a LangGraph tool-calling agent across 6 tools, with Pydantic-validated tool outputs, retry and fallback handling, and a human review queue for flagged outputs, serving about 1,000 requests a day.

Designed the agent's eval pipeline: a 150-case gold set run nightly with Langfuse tracing, root-causing regressions to specific tool calls or prompts. Hallucinations fell from 16% to under 5% and tool-selection accuracy rose to 91%.
Owned the AWS production backend, handling resource management, uptime and rollbacks, and shipped GTM MVP features with the founders.
Added Prometheus and Grafana monitoring for p95 latency, tool failure rate and cost per request, with canary rollouts for every change.

roles.title: AI Software Engineer, Summer Intern
roles.description: Built the ingestion and retrieval backbone for answering questions over archival collections.
highlights: Shipped a Python ingestion pipeline that normalized archival exports (EAD/XML, CSV, PDF) into a unified Pydantic schema, replacing 3 parsers.
Built a RAG pipeline with LangChain and pgvector that grounded answers in 40,000 indexed documents.
Cut the hallucination rate from 18% to 4%, measured by a weekly eval set of 500 queries.

roles.title: Founding Engineer
roles.description: Early engineer responsible for backend reliability, order processing and release automation.
highlights: Introduced PgBouncer connection pooling with PostgreSQL, reducing peak connection count by 85% and eliminating connection-exhaustion incidents.
Built an asynchronous order processing queue in Node.js on AWS SQS with exponential backoff retries and a dead letter queue, cutting silent order failures from 0.5% to 0.3% of daily volume.
Containerized backend services with Docker and automated CI/CD through GitHub Actions with integration tests, cutting the release cycle from 2 weeks to 1.

roles.title: Software Engineer I
roles.description: Backend engineer on enterprise integration products connecting PLM, ERP and SAP systems for customers including US defense deployments.
highlights: Built idempotent Kafka consumers with automated reconciliation across 40M+ part records, detecting and resolving 1,200+ revision mismatches per month between PLM and ERP systems.

Developed Java Spring Boot microservices for a low-code API Gateway, adding retry logic, circuit breakers and JUnit integration tests to REST, OData and SOAP adapters. This reduced failed SAP and Teamcenter sync jobs by 40%.
Built a Kubernetes operator that provisions multi-tenant connector deployments from CRDs, eliminating 200+ hand-maintained manifests.
Integrated SAML SSO, Kerberos, LDAP, OAuth and X.509 certificate authentication against customer identity providers for US defense deployments.
